body_text: {"name":"Prove","content":"\u003cp\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eJoin Us!\u003c/strong\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp\u003eAs the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers.
